headline: This update prevents text truncation in small Next panels and fixes an error when consuming items while bags are closed.

entries.title: Text fitting for small panels
entries.details: Small BetterBags Next panels now widen just enough to keep bag titles and section headers from being cut off. A new Fit Names While Open setting under Appearance > Size allows open panels to dynamically adjust their width as longer names appear.

entries.title: Error when items are consumed with bags closed
entries.details: Fixed an issue where item recalculations caused an error if an item was consumed or cleared while bags were closed, such as when crafting at a trainer.
